chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Those of you closest to me in rank on the Day of Resurrection are the best of you in character, and the best of you to their families.
ai.seo_question: What determines one's closeness to the Prophet on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this hadith to emphasize that spiritual proximity to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) is intrinsically linked to moral excellence (husn al-khuluq) and domestic kindness. This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on integrating high spiritual status with practical ethical conduct within the family unit, reflecting the broader concept of *Ahl al-Bayt* as models of perfect character.
